clauses_without_implementing_rule.quote: A passport, national identity card or equivalent official photographic document shall be obtained and its validity recorded at the time of onboarding.
Enhanced due diligence must be completed within 30 days of the relationship being established where the customer presents a high risk.

change.description: Scope the EU/UK source-of-wealth obligation to EDD, HIGH and VERY_HIGH files, and derive the trigger from the risk bundle rather than from a caller-supplied level
change.rationale: AMLD5/6 art.18 and MLR 2017 reg.33 require source of wealth as an *enhanced* measure. cdd-policy-2026.4 applied it to every file inside an EU/UK perimeter, including SDD files, which produced an OBTAIN_SOURCE_OF_WEALTH obligation on cases scoring LOW. That is a false positive with a customer-facing consequence: the obligation is routed to OPS-OUTREACH, which raises an RFI asking a low-risk customer for source of wealth. The overlay's own notes already said 'SoW required for high-risk'; the rule did not. The second half of the change hardens the trigger: the overlay now reads data.cdd.risk.result instead of input.risk, so a caller cannot switch the obligation off by asserting cdd_level SDD.
change.rego:
package jurisdiction.overlay.p2026013

import rego.v1

# Candidate rule: SoW is an enhanced measure, so it attaches to the enhanced tiers.
# Kept as a standalone predicate for review; the accepted change is applied in
# policy/jurisdiction/overlay.rego.

default requires_source_of_wealth := false

requires_source_of_wealth if {
	active_requires
	risk_level == "EDD"
}

requires_source_of_wealth if {
	active_requires
	risk_band == "HIGH"
}

requires_source_of_wealth if {
	active_requires
	risk_band == "VERY_HIGH"
}

active_requires if data.jurisdiction.overlay.active.require_source_of_wealth

risk_level := data.cdd.risk.result.cdd_level

risk_band := data.cdd.risk.result.band

validation.tests_detail: PASS: 44/44 (was 42/42; +2 tests: eu_profile_spares_a_low_risk_cdd_file_the_sow_question, us_profile_never_requires_source_of_wealth; eu_profile_requires_source_of_wealth re-scoped to high risk)

impact.materiality: MEDIUM — outcomes move but none loosen a control. One obligation is withdrawn from a LOW/SDD file that scored no risk factor; the obligation still fires on the same perimeter at HIGH (corpus case eu_profile_sow_high_risk, added with this change).

activation.reason: policy.activate is a prohibited action for every agent; a human policy owner activates the change with `make activate`
